title: plagiogyria pendula
intro: Plagiogyria pendula, commonly known as Japanese Chain Fern, is a species of fern native to East Asia. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Plagiogyria pendula include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
